pr_title: Show count of visible beatmaps at song select
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/13837

Brought across from stable. I was going to make this show more relevant information on why things are filtered, but it turns out to be a bit of a PITA. Having the count along is still beneficial I believe.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/222648607-b22bffcd-4449-41ae-ab4e-53137dd2a64d.mp4
pr_comments:
I think the text should be at the left, see [design rework](https://www.figma.com/file/DXKwqZhD5yyb1igc3mKo1P/Song-Select-Draft-2?node-id=0-1&t=KFHtYduDFI5QduY2-0):

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/225534851-e0bae167-b4a0-4314-a8b9-1b1551ef527b.png)

Users will look at the left as that is where the textbox starts. Stable also puts it there.
Didn't realise this had been added to the new design. Will match it roughly 👍 .

I've also moved the text inside the textbox. Not 100% sure on this because in the current implementation it shows a count regardless of whether a search is present or not, but let's see how it plays out.

~Since you incorporated some of the new design into the old textbox, is it also worth using the already implemented [ShearedSearchTextBox](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/master/osu.Game/Graphics/UserInterface/ShearedSearchTextBox.cs)?~ It's not a drop-in replacement as it inherits `CompositeDrawable` with the text box as a child, so maybe another time?

Edit: nvm, it may not fit in well with the surrounding old designs.
I tried and the class was not ready.

I've made a small code quality change (https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/22773/commits/695ee39b87644f4bf62a52c41b80805b7b772dff), but more importantly, also fixed an issue wherein importing or updating a beatmap set would not properly update the count of visible beatmaps (https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/22773/commits/ea8da69263ece422d6119dedc1471a8df4654a1a).

Please check that you're OK with the changes.

issue_context.title: Show number of beatmaps when searching in song select
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/13833
Originally posted by **IHaveAStrongPassword** July 8, 2021 I think it would be cool if players can see amount of beatmaps there are whenever a filter is being applied. This was a feature in osu stable as well example: star>3 star<4 results: 3405 available beatmaps
comments: I'm not honestly sure of the usefulness of such information. Does it really matter that much how many maps are matching a filter? How would the user use such information? I'm not necessarily sure that it should happen just because it was in stable.

It's useful to know how many results are matching when searching in general. It's something I like to see and I'm pretty sure I already requested this in the new song select design (so it should be there already).

@bdach im interested in resolving this issue.
What direction does the team have in mind for this issue?
I already got a solution but it is not the best, so ill like some advice and guide to do better.

Sorry for the bad english!

@OsoCoco as mentioned above this will be added as part of a larger song select redesign. however the [latest draft](https://www.figma.com/file/DXKwqZhD5yyb1igc3mKo1P/Song-Select-Draft-2?node-id=0%3A1) doesn't seem to have the count visible anywhere, so that probably needs to be added to design somewhere first and foremost.

review_comments: There was no way previously to hook an event to after a filter operation had finished.
I'd like to see this done as part of the filter process, rather than a post-execution linq. But I don't want to refactor the filter process too much just for this change.
